meta.title: Zirtuno — Complete digital ecosystems
meta.description: Software, AI, automation, data, branding and marketing — connected into one structure, built for your business to grow.

hero.eyebrow: Some forces don't need to be loud to transform.
hero.headline: We build complete digital ecosystems.
hero.subline: Software, AI, automation, data, branding and marketing — connected into one structure, built for your business to grow.

problem.headline: Most companies don't have a marketing problem. They have a structure problem.
problem.lead: Each piece works alone — and none work together. The site on one side, data on another, support improvised, processes manual. The result is effort without scale.

symptoms.label: Disconnected tools
symptoms.desc: Systems that don't talk to each other.

symptoms.label: No ecosystem
symptoms.desc: Nothing grows in an integrated way.

ecosystem.headline: We build digital ecosystems, not loose pieces.
ecosystem.lead: Everything connected around your business. Each part strengthens the others: the brand feeds the site, the site feeds traffic, traffic feeds the CRM, AI accelerates service, automation connects processes, and dashboards show it all in real time.

services.headline: Seven pillars, connected.
services.lead: Each service solves a real problem — and strengthens all the others.

web.accent: The surface where the breath lands.
web.name: Web Design & Digital Experience
web.is: Institutional sites, landing pages, and interfaces focused on conversion.
web.solves: Beautiful sites that don't convert and confusing structures that drive clients away.
web.creates: A presence that communicates clearly, builds trust, and turns visitors into clients.

software.name: Software & App Development
software.is: Custom platforms, internal systems, dashboards, and apps.
software.solves: Manual processes, loose spreadsheets, and tools that don't talk.
software.creates: Faster, organized, scalable operations, with technology built for the business.

ai.accent: The intelligence that does not sleep.
ai.name: Artificial Intelligence
ai.is: AI agents, chatbots, intelligent automations, and automated service.
ai.solves: Slow service, overloaded teams, and opportunities lost after hours.
ai.creates: Service and operations running 24/7, with intelligence that scales.

automation.name: Automation & Integrations
automation.is: Process automation, CRM integrations, and tool connection.
automation.solves: Repetitive tasks, rework, and data lost between systems.
automation.creates: A connected flow where information moves on its own and nothing is lost.

data.name: Data & Dashboards
data.is: Data organization, BI, reports, and decision dashboards.
data.solves: Decisions in the dark, scattered data, and no view of the numbers.
data.creates: A clear, real-time view to decide with data, not guesswork.

branding.name: Branding & Positioning
branding.is: Visual identity, brand strategy, communication, and positioning.
branding.solves: A generic brand, undifferentiated, that isn't remembered.
branding.creates: A strong, coherent, memorable brand that builds authority.

marketing.name: Marketing & Growth
marketing.is: Paid traffic, content strategy, campaigns, and performance.
marketing.solves: Investment with no clear return and stagnant growth.
marketing.creates: Predictable, measurable growth, connected to the whole structure.

method.headline: The Zirtuno Method.
method.lead: We don't start with what's beautiful. We start with what's broken.

phases.name: Diagnosis
phases.desc: We understand the business, map the current structure, and identify what's fragmented, manual, or missing.

phases.name: Structure
phases.desc: We design the ecosystem architecture: what to build, in what order, and how it connects.

phases.name: Construction
phases.desc: We build each piece at a premium standard — site, software, brand, automations.

phases.name: Integration
phases.desc: We connect everything: CRM, AI, automations, data, and systems operating as one organism.

phases.name: Evolution
phases.desc: We measure, optimize, and expand. The ecosystem grows with the business.

work.headline: Selected work.
work.lead: Real structures, built piece by piece.
work.indexLead: Digital ecosystems and architectures built by Zirtuno.

name.b1: It began with two brothers and a single restlessness: what if we built what doesn't exist yet?
name.b2: From one vision, three pillars were born — social, health, and finance. The forces that move every business and every life.
name.b3: Zirtuno was born to turn ideas into structure — to give form to the systems, solutions, and technologies still waiting to exist.
name.b4: From two brothers to a complete digital studio. From an idea to an ecosystem — software, AI, automation, branding, and strategy.
name.closing: We build what doesn't exist yet.
name.graceNote: ZIRTUNO — the breath that gives shape.

studio.whoLead: A small, multidisciplinary team, organized by function.
studio.closingItalic: We are about being felt, remembered, and carried forward.
